title: Clearinv
description: ClearInv is a simple and useful plugin that allows players to quickly clear their inventory. Permissions can be easily managed using LuckPerms.
body:
ClearInv is a lightweight and user-friendly Minecraft plugin that allows players to clear their inventory with a simple command. It is designed to be easy to use while giving server administrators full control over who can access the feature. Permissions can be managed through LuckPerms, making it simple to assign or restrict access to specific players or groups.

Whether you want to free up inventory space, quickly reset before an event, or provide a convenient utility command for your community, ClearInv offers a fast and reliable solution. The plugin is optimized for performance, easy to configure, and works seamlessly on a wide range of Minecraft servers. Its simplicity and efficiency make it a great addition to survival, creative, minigame, and network servers alike.
